name: Ongoing project management
description: A project manager on hand for as long as you need one, across every project you have running. Useful for small and medium-sized businesses, studios and agencies that need senior delivery support without a full-time hire.
bestFor: Small and medium-sized businesses, creative studios and agencies with steady project flow and uneven capacity.
included: Embedded across the active project slate, with weekly capacity review.
Single point of contact for clients, partners, and internal teams.
Process improvements documented as they are made.
Standing weekly review with you and your team leads.
Clean exit plan available at any point with 30 days' notice.
